interpretation: Literal reading: the light and the heavy are moved either by what generated them and made them light or heavy, or by what removed the hindrance (255b35-256a2). The remover moves only per accidens (255b24-27: κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς γὰρ κινεῖ, like the wall that a rebounding ball does not move), so the mover is either a per se mover or a per accidens one.
